title: Canadian Tempeh Hash
description: A hearty, homemade breakfast or brunch dish featuring tempeh and a hash of potatoes and vegetables.
instructions: Cut the tempeh into small pieces and set aside.
Dice the potatoes, onion, and bell pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced potatoes, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the potatoes are golden brown.
Add the tempeh to the skillet and cook until it is golden brown and crispy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Serve with toast or eggs for a more filling meal.
